# Priscilla Grant

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v3 c4 P20](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0020)</sub>
- **Role:** student  <sub>[v3 c5 P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Prissy  <sub>[v3 c3 P14](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0014)</sub>; Pris  <sub>[v3 c9 P20](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0020)</sub>

## Appearance

Priscilla is described as golden and fair. She wears silk attire on special visits.

_Sources: [v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022)_

## Personality

Priscilla has a warm, jovial, and pragmatic nature. She frequently laughs at amusing situations and offers sensible, realistic advice to her companions when planning for the future.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P23](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0023), [v3 c5 P1](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0001), [v3 c9 P17](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0017), [v3 c9 P21](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0021)_

## Traits

- practical  <sub>[v3 c9 P17](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0017)</sub>
- good-humored  <sub>[v3 c4 P23](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0023), [v3 c5 P1](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0001)</sub>

- teaching  <sub>[v3 c3 P15](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0015)</sub>

## Goals

- to find suitable housing while studying at Redmond College  <sub>[v3 c9 P16](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0016), [v3 c9 P18](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0018)</sub>

## History

Priscilla previously taught school in Carmody before continuing her education. She moves to Kingsport to attend Redmond College, arriving shortly before Anne Shirley to arrange accommodations. While at Redmond, she forms a close trio with Anne and their new acquaintance Philippa Gordon, joining the active social life of the university. After spending their first year in a boardinghouse, Priscilla and Anne search for a house to rent for their remaining studies. They successfully secure Patty's Place on Spofford Avenue, where they arrange to live with Philippa Gordon and Stella Maynard under the care of Stella's aunt.

_Sources: [v3 c3 P10](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0010), [v3 c3 P13](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0013), [v3 c3 P15](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0015), [v3 c5 P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c9 P16](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0016), [v3 c9 P18](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0018), [v3 c9 P29](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0029), [v3 c10 P47](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0047)_
